changelog:
幻念推送与配对体验修复（1.6.1）

🔗 配对时只确认同意/拒绝，逐项权限移到设备详情。
📨 幻念消息带应用名、标题与正文；发送人可显示备注或设备名。
🔔 新增通知自检，锁屏/声音/震动/悬浮逐项检查并给厂商路径。
🛠️ 修复长锁屏收不到、一直发送中、暂停误切备用、双通道历史缺行、聚合行不可点、注册限流十余小时等问题。
🧩 更新界面更紧凑；大陆/海外各用各的 CDN。
⚠️ 覆盖升级保留全部设置；幻念身份密钥与口令仍不进备份。
changelogEn:
Fnthink Push and pairing experience fixes (1.6.1)

🔗 Pairing asks approve/deny only; per-item permissions moved to device details.
📨 Fnthink messages now carry app name, title and body; the sender can show alias or device name.
🔔 New notification self-check covers lock-screen, sound, vibration and heads-up with OEM paths.
🛠️ Fixed long lock-screen misses, stuck sending, paused-to-backup switching, missing channel rows, unclickable merged rows and 12-hour registration rate limits.
🧩 More compact update UI; mainland and overseas sites use their own CDNs.
⚠️ Overlay upgrades preserve all settings; identity keys and secrets stay out of backups.
